name: Imaging Insights
description: OCT (macula, RNFL, anterior), fundus photography, FAF, angiography (FA/ICG), autorefraction, topography, biometry, and ultrasound — reading and interpreting images.

episodes.title: OCT Principles: The Low-Coherence Interferometry
episodes.description: How optical coherence tomography works and why it revolutionized retinal and glaucoma care.

episodes.title: Macular OCT: The Nine Layers and the Pathology
episodes.description: A reproducible read sequence — ILM to RPE — and the fluid, drusen, atrophy patterns.

episodes.title: OCT RNFL: The Glaucoma Map and the Red-Yellow-Green
episodes.description: The quadrant and clock-hour thickness, the normative comparison, and the asymmetry that flags early loss.

episodes.title: OCT Ganglion Cell Analysis: The Macular Glaucoma Complement
episodes.description: The GCL+IPL layer, the hemifield asymmetry, and the early detection role before RNFL loss.

episodes.title: OCT Angiography: The Non-Invasive Vasculature
episodes.description: The en-face flow, the superficial and deep capillary plexus, and the FAZ measurement.

episodes.title: Anterior Segment OCT: The Angle and the Cornea
episodes.description: Imaging the angle without gonioscopy, the scleral lens vault, and the corneal opacity behind.

episodes.title: Fundus Photography: The Standard Fields and the Montage
episodes.description: The seven standard fields, the stereo pair, and the widefield montage that captures the periphery.

episodes.title: Ultra-Widefield Imaging: The 200-Degree View
episodes.description: The optos and the color and FAF, the periphery in one shot, and the lesions it reveals.

episodes.title: Fundus Autofluorescence: The Lipofuscin Map
episodes.description: The hyper- and hypo-patterns in AMD, Stargardt, hydroxychloroquine, and the retinal toxicity.

episodes.title: Fluorescein Angiography: The Phases and the Patterns
episodes.description: The arterial, capillary, venous, and late phases — leakage, pooling, blocking, window defect.

episodes.title: ICG Angiography: The Choroidal Vasculature
episodes.description: When ICG beats FA — occult CNV, PCV, and the choroidal lesions that FA cannot resolve.

episodes.title: Corneal Topography: The Axial, Tangential, and Elevation
episodes.description: Reading the color map, the bowtie of astigmatism, and the inferior steepening of keratoconus.

episodes.title: Tomography: The Pentacam and the Scheimpflug
episodes.description: The 3D corneal reconstruction, the pachymetry map, and the ectasia screening indices.

episodes.title: Wavefront Aberrometry: The Total Eye Aberration
episodes.description: The Hartmann-Shack sensor, the higher-order map, and the customized ablation it enables.

episodes.title: Biometry: The IOL Calculation and the Axial Length
episodes.description: The immersion and optical, the SRK/T and Hoffer Q, and the post-refractive challenge.
